SELECT TO_CHAR(c.stat_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS dd, COUNT(1) AS num FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_CLINIC_MASTER c INNER JOIN TR_DEPT_DICT d ON c.dept_code = d.dept_code WHERE c.stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
GROUP BY c.stat_date

SELECT TO_CHAR(a.appoint_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS dd, SUM(a.appoint_count) AS num FROM tr_fc_appoint a LEFT JOIN TR_DEPT_DICT d ON a.dept_code = d.dept_code WHERE a.appoint_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
GROUP BY a.appoint_date
SELECT TO_CHAR(h.hol_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') FROM tr_fc_holiday h WHERE h.hol_type = 'LEGAL_HOLIDAY' AND h.hol_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
